Name: Enchanted Rose Decor (new colors available)
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
🌹 Enchanted Rose (CP) – Stardew Valley Mod By Abrah 🌹
Is available in 7 different colors: Lilac, red, black, white, ice blue, light pink, default.
[line]📥 Installation GuideRequirements:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/utility/smapi]SMAPI by pathoschild[/url] – Stardew Valley mod loader.
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher by pathoschild[/url] – framework to load the mod.
[/list]Steps:
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip this mod.

[*]Locate your Stardew Valley Mods folder:
[list]
[*]Microsoft Store: [code]C:\XboxGames\Stardew Valley\Content\Mods[/code]
[*]Mac: [code]~/Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[*]Linux: [code]~/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[/list]
[*]Place the Enchanted Rose (CP) folder into your Mods folder. Please do not place the whole zip file in the mods folder.

[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.

[/list][line]🌸 How to Get It In The Game[list]
[*]The Enchanted Rose can be found in Robin’s Furniture Catalogue for free.
[*]Once obtained, it can be placed as decor and set on tables in your farmhouse or cabin.
[/list][line]💖 Design by Abrah
Spanish translation available- by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hayato2236/mods]Hayato2236[/url]
